title: Bioluminescent Sea Turtle
description: A large green sea turtle swims through dark water, its shell and flippers detailed with realistic scales. Surrounding the turtle is a glowing purple and pink ethereal aura composed of translucent bubbles and luminous rings emitting soft light.
prompt: A majestic green sea turtle with detailed scaly shell and flippers swimming through dark ocean depths, surrounded by a flowing ethereal aura of translucent purple and pink glowing bubbles and luminous rings that emit soft bioluminescent light, dramatic god rays filtering from above, mystical and surreal atmosphere, dark moody background with subtle golden highlights
